claims.text: Several reviewers report no visible lash growth or change after using the product, sometimes for weeks or over a month.
Some users experienced irritation, including burning eyelids or eyelash fallout.
Many reviewers report positive results such as fuller, longer, or stronger lashes.
Some users with sensitive eyes or allergies found the serum gentle and non-irritating.
A few reviewers note results take time, with improvements appearing gradually over weeks.
